item.tib: shes phyin rgyan 'grel dang bcas kyi skabs dang po'i smad cha srid khams kyi mtha' dpyod dbyar gyi rnga sgra blo gsar mdongs mtha' dga' ba'i dgyes glu
item.coloph: smras pa/ bskal bzang dge ba'i 'byung gnas gser ri'i yongs su bskor dbus na/ snying stobs phul byung pad dkar ltar bsngags dmu sras ri dbang gi gsung gi phrin las rtsib stong 'khor yug gsum las legs 'ongs pa'i/ zab rgyas brgyad khri'i bon phung nyi ma'i mdzod chen kun du brdal// de las sbas don sher phyin zab mo chu klung 'bum/ rnam dpyod hub gcig gis thung dpal chen bya ha nu'i/ zhal las 'khrungs pa'i nying khu mngon rtogs lam rim gyi/ legs bshad rmad 'byung bu mo dga' ston mgron du mtshar// rgyal yum dgongs don lha yi rdzing ring por/ dpyod ldan mkha' la 'khor bas gzhal dka' na/ thos bsam shed ma bye ba'i 'dab g.yo ba/ rwa yig gnyis pa bdag 'dras ga la 'os// 'on kyang sum ldan bla ma gar dbang pas/ byang khams bshad sgrub dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ gtan tshigs rig pa'i sa bon gsar bskrun na/ phan bde'i g.yur du smin zhes spyir son bzhin// g.yung drung rab brtan thos bsam 'dus sde yi/ zhing sar tha snyad bshad pa'i son btab kyang*/ blo rmongs gzhung don snyi phon smin dka' la/ mtha' dpyod go bde'i chu yis bran dgos zhes// rnam kun bstan 'gror phan bde'i lhag bsam can/ yongs 'dzin drang srong g.yung drung blo ldan gtsos/ blo gsal 'ga' yis bskul ma nan lci gshis/ tshur mthong byis blo bdag gis 'di nyid byas// kho bo mthong myong med pa'i mthong gtam bzhin/ gzhung lugs thos bsam dag pa'i gzu lum la/ dpyod ldan dbyings khrel med ngos dogs sel gyi/ mchid tshig gsol dang mchog gsum spyan sngar bshags// 'on te deng dus rgyal bstan nyams dma' skabs/ lhag bsam cung zad la yang bsod nams stobs/ ches cher 'gyur ba dri med lung bzhin du/ 'dir 'bad kyis mtshon dus gsum rnam dkar mthus/ rnam 'dren brgya ba'i mgon po'i bstan pa 'di/ srid pa'i khams kun cher rgyas yun gnas nas/ de tshul 'dzin pa'i skyes chen tshogs rnams kyang*/ sku tshe phrin las gong nas gong 'phel shog/ mtha' yas ma rgan dbyig 'dzin snying du byang chub sems kyi sa bon zhugs/ g.yung drung sems spyod zab mo'i rlan gyis rab bskyed theg chen mos spyod kyi/ ljang bu smin nas mthong dang sgom pa'i lam gyi snyi phon cher rgyas shing / srid khams dngos bstan gtso bor gyur ba'i 'bras bu rnam mkhyen g.yur za shog// zhes shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa mngon rtogs lam gyi rim pa 'grel ba dang bcas kyi skabs dang po srid khams kyi mtha' dpyod dbyar gyi rnga sgra blo gsar mdongs mtha' dga' ba'i dgyes glu re zhig rdzogs so//
